messages:
ella: FYI I opened a docs PR that consolidates model-card->catalog migration steps, plus new examples for embedding sharding and long-context best practices. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/511
kevin: nice. can we add an explicit 16k context example for polaris13b? some customers expect unbounded context.
ella: added a short section titled 'Long context expectations' with this curl example (keeps it simple):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"polaris13b","input":"<1..>","max_tokens":256,"sequence_length":16384}'
```
sam: minor nit: sequence_length is an internal hint; recommend using the 'context_window' key in docs to match SDKs. also call out truncation fallback behaviour.
kevin: also add a note about batching: for >8k sequences, small batch windows can increase token latency. suggest a sample config for batch_window_ms=25 for latency-sensitive apps.
lee: on embedding sharding - please include an example of shard_count mismatch causing cosine resets. i added a comment with pseudo-code for client-side reassembly and a pointer to the Embed API section.
ella: updated embedding sharding snippet. new example shows stitching 3 shards and preserving original order. included a one-line warning about changing shard_count mid-indexing.
linter-bot: Link check failed: /docs/catalog#supported-models -> 404. probable anchor rename to /docs/catalog#available-models.
ella: thanks bot, fixed all catalog links and replaced any runtime#fallback usage with runtime#fallback-policies.
kevin: can we include a short Go SDK snippet for quantized fallback? some platform teams use Go.
ella: added go snippet using 'quant_fallback=true' param (calls out model_alias behavior). snippet: 
```go
import "github.com/redwood-inference/go-client"
client := client.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
res, _ := client.Generate(context.Background(), client.GenerateParams{Model: "polaris13b", QuantFallback: true, Input: "hello"})
```
sam: benchmarks section looks good but add a p50/p95 table for polaris13b on A100-80GB vs T4 to set realistic expectations. i pasted small numbers from infra bench: p50=18 tok/s (A100), p95=6 tok/s (T4).
lee: added a short sentence about Dedicated autoscale: committed throughput isn't free, and scale-up can take ~30s for heavy models. callers should prefer pre-warming for steady high throughput.
ella: merged the editorial suggestions into the PR. leaving the checklist to reviewers: 1) anchors fixed, 2) long-context example present, 3) embedding shard stitch example, 4) Go SDK snippet added, 5) bench numbers cited.
kevin: i'll review for wording and then approve. no other blockers. :+1:
sam: approving after a tiny grammar tweak.
lee: good to go from infra.
linter-bot: Preview build OK: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/511 (build 7540) :white_check_mark:
ella: thanks everyone 44b merging after CI green. if anyone wants the snippets in a different language format ping me.
